note: Deterministic demo catalog. All prices are integer paise (100 paise = INR 1).

products.title: Aurora Wireless Optical Mouse
products.description: Compact 2.4GHz wireless mouse with a silent-tracking optical sensor, ambidextrous shell and a single AA cell that lasts most of a year. Plug the nano receiver in and it works with no driver install.

products.title: Aurora Silent Click Mouse
products.description: Budget wireless mouse tuned for shared offices and late-night desks. The micro switches are damped so clicks stay under 25 decibels while keeping a crisp tactile break.

products.title: Nimbus TKL Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable tactile brown switches, double-shot PBT keycaps and a detachable braided USB-C cable. No RGB and no software, just a keyboard.

products.title: Nimbus Wireless Keyboard
products.description: Low-profile scissor-switch wireless keyboard that pairs with three devices over Bluetooth and switches between them with a dedicated key. Rechargeable over USB-C.

products.title: Kestrel Pro ANC Headphones
products.description: Flagship over-ear headphones with hybrid active noise cancellation, 40mm drivers and forty hours of playback. Ships with a hard case and a wired fallback cable for flights.

products.title: Kestrel Wired Earphones
products.description: In-ear wired earphones with an inline mic and a tangle-resistant flat cable. Tuned slightly warm for long calls rather than for bass.

products.title: Volt 65W GaN Fast Charger
products.description: Two-port gallium nitride charger that fits an Indian wall socket without blocking the neighbouring plug. Delivers 65W to a laptop or splits across a phone and a laptop.

products.title: Volt 10000mAh Power Bank
products.description: Pocketable 10000mAh power bank with 22.5W pass-through charging and a small OLED readout for the exact remaining percentage. Airline-safe capacity.

products.title: Lumen 1080p Streaming Webcam
products.description: 1080p60 webcam with a real glass lens, dual noise-cancelling mics and a physical privacy shutter that slides over the sensor rather than switching it off in software.

products.title: Cascade 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
products.description: Aluminium USB-C hub with HDMI 4K60, gigabit ethernet, two USB-A ports, SD and microSD readers and 100W power passthrough for the host laptop.

products.title: Aurora Vertical Ergonomic Mouse
products.description: Wireless vertical mouse that holds the wrist at 57 degrees to take load off the forearm. Recommended for anyone spending the whole day on a trackpad.

products.title: Lumen Desk Ring Light 10-inch
products.description: Ten-inch bi-colour ring light on a weighted desk stand with stepless dimming from 2700K to 6500K. Clamps a phone or sits behind a webcam.

products.title: Meridian Aluminium Laptop Stand
products.description: Folding aluminium laptop riser that lifts a 13 to 16 inch machine to eye level and collapses flat enough for a backpack. Silicone pads keep the lid from sliding.

products.title: Meridian Single Monitor Arm
products.description: Gas-spring single monitor arm with a desk clamp and a grommet mount in the box. Holds up to a 32 inch panel and routes the cable through the arm.

products.title: Quill A5 Dotted Notebook
products.description: A5 hardbound notebook, 192 pages of 120gsm dotted paper that does not ghost under a fountain pen. Lies flat thanks to a stitched signature binding.

products.title: Quill Gel Pen Pack of 10
products.description: Pack of ten 0.5mm gel pens with quick-dry ink that will not smear under the side of a left hand. Six black, two blue, two red.

products.title: Meridian Ergonomic Desk Chair
products.description: Mesh-back task chair with adjustable lumbar support, 3D armrests and a synchro-tilt mechanism. Assembles in about fifteen minutes with the supplied hex key.

products.title: Meridian Under-Desk Cable Tray
products.description: Steel under-desk cable tray that screws or clamps on and hides a power strip plus a laptop brick. Keeps the floor clear for a vacuum.

products.title: Quill Bamboo Desk Organiser
products.description: Bamboo desk organiser with a phone slot, a pen well and two shallow trays for cards and keys. Sanded smooth and finished with food-safe oil.

products.title: Meridian Anti-Fatigue Standing Mat
products.description: Polyurethane standing desk mat with a bevelled edge so a chair rolls over it without catching. Takes the ache out of a two-hour standing block.

products.title: Terra Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask 1L
products.description: Double-walled 18/8 stainless steel flask that holds tea hot for twelve hours and water cold for twenty-four. The lid doubles as a 200ml cup.

products.title: Terra Cast Iron Dosa Tawa
products.description: Pre-seasoned cast iron tawa, 10 inches across with a low rim for an easy spatula angle. Gets better with every dosa; hand wash and wipe with oil.

products.title: Terra Pour-Over Coffee Kit
products.description: Borosilicate pour-over dripper, a 600ml server and fifty paper filters. Makes two mugs at a time without any electricity.

products.title: Terra Airtight Storage Jar Set of 4
products.description: Four borosilicate storage jars with bamboo lids and silicone gaskets, sized for dal, rice, sugar and coffee. Stack without wobbling.

products.title: Halo LED Table Lamp
products.description: Dimmable LED desk lamp with a flicker-free driver and a memory that returns to the last brightness. Warm 3000K by default, cool 6000K on a long press.

products.title: Terra Bamboo Chopping Board
products.description: End-grain bamboo chopping board with a juice groove and a recessed handle. Kinder to knife edges than plastic and lighter than teak.

products.title: Halo Aroma Diffuser 300ml
products.description: Ultrasonic aroma diffuser with a 300ml tank, an auto cut-off when dry and a night mode that turns every light off but keeps the mist running.

products.title: Stride TPE Yoga Mat 6mm
products.description: Six millimetre TPE yoga mat with an alignment print and a closed-cell surface that does not soak up sweat. Comes with a carry strap.

products.title: Stride Resistance Band Set
products.description: Five fabric resistance bands from light to extra heavy with a door anchor and two handles. Fabric rather than latex, so they do not roll up the thigh.

products.title: Stride Adjustable Dumbbell 20kg
products.description: Single adjustable dumbbell that dials from 2.5kg to 20kg in 2.5kg steps, replacing eight fixed pairs. Cast iron plates with a knurled steel handle.

products.title: Stride Foam Roller 45cm
products.description: High-density EVA foam roller with a textured surface for calves, quads and the upper back. Holds its shape past a hundred kilos.

products.title: Pulse Smart Fitness Band
products.description: Fitness band with continuous heart rate, SpO2 spot checks and a fourteen day battery. Syncs over Bluetooth to a phone app with no subscription.

products.title: Stride Steel Skipping Rope
products.description: Ball-bearing skipping rope with a coated steel cable that can be cut to length and weighted aluminium handles. Built for speed work rather than beginners.
